notes.title: The AI Revolution Update: Buster's Tower Defense
notes.notes:
Join us as we unveil the future of strategy gaming in "The AI Revolution Update" for Buster's Tower Defense. This groundbreaking update introduces levels designed by artificial intelligence, bringing a new layer of unpredictability and challenge to your strategy.

https://i.imgur.com/8UtnQaQ.jpg

As AI reshapes industries, it now enters the realm of Buster's Tower Defense, offering you an unprecedented gaming experience. This update isn't just about new content; it's a glimpse into the future of gaming where AI and human creativity merge to create dynamic battlefields.

With this update, you'll face off against AI that learns from your tactics, forcing you to evolve your strategy continually. The "AI Revolution Update" doesn't just challenge your strategic skills; it challenges the notion of what's possible in game design.

Prepare for new towers, enemies, and puzzles—all curated by an AI that's been taught to test your limits. Are you ready to tackle the challenge and prove your strategic prowess? Update your game, join the event, and let's find out if you can outsmart the AI revolution in Buster's Tower Defense.

Don't miss out on special launch day events, including live streams, Q&A sessions with the developers, and unique in-game rewards for early adopters. See how you stack up against the best players with new leaderboards and share your most impressive victories with the community.

The future is here, and it's waiting for you in Buster's Tower Defense. Are you ready to command the digital frontier?

notes.title: Buster's Tower Defense - Official Name Change Update!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/54OQfSK.jpeg

Scuffed Tower Defense has officially been renamed to BUSTER'S Tower Defense. Buster is still one scuffed dog, but we thought it would be more fitting to have the game named after him because he is such a big star.

The second campaign level (Snow Day) has been completed and is complete with new cutscenes and dialogs featuring your favorite uncle Sherald. There is now an achievement for beating this campaign level.

https://i.imgur.com/18Bd3qg.jpeg

Check out Buster's Tower Defense today! 50% off!!!

notes.title: Scuffed Update 0.57
notes.notes:
Epic Update Incoming: Two new maps, custom textures, and UI enhancements!
New Feature: Add your own bot images
[olist]
 You can now upload custom images that will show up on your bots.
 Simply add your png files to the TowerD/Content/Textures folder where STD is installed.
 IE: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\std\TowerD\Content\Textures
 There is a new SCUFFED map called TextureTest that can be used to see all of your textures in game. The map also lets you spawn in any enemies you want (epic).
[/olist]

New Map: The Fall
It's time to put 3D Physics-based Tower Defense to the test. Can you stop the bots before they get to your platform and destroy the base? When they fall...they fall fast.
https://i.imgur.com/6GshrBs.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/M6IM0nY.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/XSk4sGX.jpg

New Steam Integration: Achievements and Cloud Saves

 Level unlocks are now saved on the Steam Cloud
 Custom bot images are now saved on the Steam Cloud
 Added two unlockable achievements. Many more to come.


Gameplay Enhancements

 Made it harder to spam walls to block paths
 Reworked wall/tower path blocking. Towers and walls now have health. When enemies are blocked they will damage the building based on their attack damage
 Unplaced walls no longer affect pathing
 Added ability to fast forward for 2x game speed. Press the T key for fasTer everything.


Bug Fixes

 Unplaced walls no longer affect pathing
 Drone attachment can no longer be destroyed
 UI looks less trashy but still SCUFFED (Windows XP -> Windows Vista). More to come soon. 
 Improved level lighting (for some levels)
 Added more bugs to fix later


Special thanks to SCUFFED player Shanaz's faulty clone for bug feedback and congratulations on being the first to 'finish' the challenge levels available

notes.title: Demo Release - 0.52
notes.notes:
A major update to the Scuffed Tower Defense Demo. 0.52 Patch notes:
UE4 Engine Upgrade

 Project upgraded to UE4 Version 4.26
 Now only available in Win64
 Reduced install size by more than half


New Enemies

 ShieldBot - Has a protective shield that blocks large projectiles. Shield bursts when the bot falls below 25% health
 PlanetaryShieldBot - Has a massive shield that blocks a large region and protects other bots


New Demo Map

 The Crater - A large map where you must defend your base in the middle of a crater. Enemies will swarm your base from all directions


https://i.imgur.com/RQfW56b.jpg
https://i.imgur.com/Ru1gex4.jpg

UI Enhancements

 Replaced Gold icon with Doge
 Added sound options
 Added new tower info to pad: damage, attack speed, level
 Added drone enhancement button which adds an attachment to the drone that fires two homing lasers at enemies
 Added load screen (with temporary images)
 Removed images of peckers from Discord


Player Control Enhancements

 Drone movement takes into account Delta time and is smoother across lower framerates

notes.title: Demo Release 0.51
notes.notes:
A major update to the Scuffed Tower Defense Demo. 0.51 Patch notes:
New Enemies

 BigMama - Spawns 2 OrbRunners upon death
 BigDaddy - Spawns 2 BigMama's upon death
 BiggerBoss - Moves slow, hard to kill
 BiggestBoss - Moves super slow, massive, impossible to kill, spawns enemies every 2 seconds, cannot attack
 Added new object that prevents towers from spawning in select areas


New Demo Map

 The Bridge - low gravity space map where enemies try to cross a large bridge to destroy the gravity generator. Knock enemies off into the abyss with MagmaTowers and RocketTowers


https://i.imgur.com/zyWimIV.jpg

UI Enhancements

 Added options menu for graphics settings
 Added level select menu for demo levels
 Added enemy health count to pad
 Added tower kill count to pad
 Tooltips added to buttons
 Hover over tower buttons to see prices and description
 Minor tweeks


Player Control Enhancements

 Drone is now always in fast move
 Shift is now slow move button
 Pressing shift while placing towers will continue to spawn the selected tower (like walls)
 Drone can no longer clip through walls and now physically interacts with the environment
 Placed buildings no longer collide with objects
